name: pi-slop-review
description: Native diff review window for AI coding agents (pi, Claude Code, Codex CLI). Opens a Monaco-powered review UI in a Glimpse window so you can leave inline / file-level / overall comments on the agent's slop, then have the agent address each item. Adapted f
